title: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Link Following Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escape the low integrity sandbox on affected installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Print Spooler service. The service can be abused to create an arbitrary file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user at medium integrity.
